subtitle: Lesson 9 · Authentication for Integrations

code:
No human involved:

ServiceNow  --(client ID + secret)-->  Token endpoint
ServiceNow  <--(short-lived access token)--
ServiceNow  --(token on Authorization header)-->  External API
caption: The integration authenticates as itself — server to server.

code:
A specific human is involved:

User  --(logs in, consents)-->  External provider
External provider  --(authorization code)-->  ServiceNow
ServiceNow  --(code)-->  Token endpoint  --(access token)-->  ServiceNow
caption: The resulting token represents that user's own authorization.
